{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows with invalid age (-1)
valid_age_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean age of customers with valid age: {mean_age}')"}
